consumer: An external combat-log analysis script that reads each exported monster's current HP integer as a numeric data point; it asks 'what is this monster's raw HP value', not a yes/no the engine computes.
scope: Each exported monster entity's own raw current-HP field (per-monster), not a possession/inventory reach and not visibility-filtered.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) writes mon.get_hp() straight from the engine getter as the raw integer HP value; Creature::sees (Excerpt 1) is irrelevant and Excerpt 2 is the avatar, not the monster.
divergence: A monster behind a wall (unseen, out of LOS) sitting at 30/100 HP: a wrong answer that treated this as a display proxy (D) and filtered through visibility would report null/last-seen, but raw-state export must report 30 regardless of whether it is currently seen.
